# Nabaperks

> Nabaperks is a browser-based loyalty service for UK food and drink venues. Customers use a venue QR code to open a loyalty card, collect venue-linked stamps and redeem rewards without installing an app.

## Service facts

- Each stamp claim is linked to the venue QR, saved membership and live programme, with one claim per customer per UK date.
- Optional location checks can flag unusual claims.
- Loyalty participation and marketing consent are separate.
- Nabaperks is operated by Lapen Inns.
- Public contact and privacy contact: info@lapeninns.com.
